description:
List the workspaces this account can act in, each with its uuid. Agency / multi-brand accounts have more than one (e.g. a workspace per client); a single account just has Default. The store / product / order / design tools operate on the Default workspace unless you pass workspace=<uuid>. Use this FIRST to resolve a workspace by name (e.g. a client's name) to the uuid those tools need. Read-only.

[#358d40]
name: list_my_workspaces
